summary.text: Bob Welch is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 92 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His campaign website describes him as a seasoned executive with 35 years of experience building businesses.

paragraphs.text: Welch's campaign website says he would focus on core issues affecting District 92 and the state.
The priorities it lists include reducing spending and taxes, addressing the high cost of living, creating jobs, promoting business and supporting public service agencies.
